8800: Stand under the smith bar with one foot slightly behind the other.
Grip the bar and unrack it.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and the bar close to your legs.
Lower until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Switch which foot is forward after your set.
8847: Stand in the machine with pads against your arms.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
8873: Lie on your back with a dumbbell secured between your feet.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Bring your knees toward your chest.
Lower your feet slowly without touching the floor.
8874: Place a band around your thighs or ankles.
Take quick small steps to the side.
Keep tension on the band and your chest up.
8875: Lie on your back with the ankle strap attached to the low cable and one foot in it.
Brace your core and press your lower back into the floor.
Pull the knee up toward your chest with control.
Pause briefly, then lower the leg slowly against the cable.
Keep the other leg relaxed and your hips still.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
8876: Lie on your back with the cable attached to both ankles or a strap around your feet.
Start with your legs extended and your core braced.
Pull your knees toward your chest in a smooth curl.
Pause at the top without lifting your head.
Lower your legs slowly until they are almost straight.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor throughout.
8877: Loop a light band around your fingers and thumb of one hand.
Rest your forearm on a table or your thigh.
Start with the fingers curled in a relaxed fist.
Spread your fingers open against the band's pull.
Close them back slowly with control.
Do all reps, then switch hands.
8878: Set two cable handles at a low or mid height and grab them crossed over.
Hinge forward at the hips to about 45 degrees with a flat back.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the handles out and back in a wide arc until your arms are in line with your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades gently at the end.
Return slowly and keep your torso still.
8879: Kneel on one knee side-on to the cable with the handle at chest height.
Hold the handle near your shoulder with your elbow bent.
Brace your core and keep your hips square.
Rotate your forearm outward, then press the handle overhead.
Return along the same path with control.
Finish your reps and switch sides.
8880: Stand facing away from the cable with the handle at chest height in one hand.
Take a staggered stance and keep your core tight.
Punch the handle forward quickly, rotating your hips a little.
Stop just before your elbow locks out.
Return the hand with control to your chin.
Do all reps, then switch arms.
8881: Sit beside a low cable and hold the handle with your forearm resting on your thigh.
Start with your palm facing up and your wrist neutral.
Rotate your forearm so the palm turns down.
Pause, then rotate back slowly against the cable.
Keep your elbow still and move only the forearm.
Complete your reps and switch arms.
8882: Hold the wrist roller with a neutral, thumbs-up grip and your arms out in front.
Let the weight hang from the rope with the rope unwound.
Roll the bar with your wrists to wind the rope up.
Keep your arms steady and your shoulders relaxed.
When the weight reaches the bar, lower it slowly by unwinding.
Stop if your forearms burn too much to keep control.
8891: Place the weighted bag across your upper back and hold it in place.
Stand with your feet hip width and your knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lower your torso with a flat back.
Go down until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.
Keep your neck neutral all the way.
8892: Stand with one foot slightly behind the other.
Hold a kettlebell in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bell toward the floor.
Keep your back flat and weight mostly on the front foot.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
8894: Start in a push-up position with a straight body.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Return the leg and repeat on the other side.
8895: Set up on the 45 degree bench with your hips on the pad and your feet locked in.
Cross your arms or hold them out wide.
Raise your torso until your body forms a straight line.
At the top, pull your shoulder blades together.
Lower back down slowly without rounding.
Do not overarch at the top.
8896: Stand and hinge forward with a flat back and your arms hanging.
At the top, pull your shoulder blades together.
Lower back to the bent over position slowly.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.
8899: Stand facing the low cable with a handle in each hand or one handle at a time.
Start with your arms low and a slight bend in your elbows.
Lift your arms up and out to form a Y shape.
Keep your thumbs pointing up and your ribs down.
Lower slowly back to the start.
